scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/companion-api && npm ci --prefix packages/shared && npm ci --prefix packages/viewer && npm ci --prefix packages/photo-room && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop && npm ci --prefix apps/mobile && npm ci --prefix apps/server-admin && npm ci --prefix apps/website
scripts.desktop:build: npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run budget
scripts.mobile:build: npm --prefix apps/mobile run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run budget
scripts.server-admin:build: npm --prefix apps/server-admin run build && npm --prefix apps/server-admin run budget
scripts.rust:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-features
scripts.test: npm run companion-api:test && npm run shared:test && npm run viewer:test && npm run desktop:test && npm run mobile:test && npm run server-admin:test && npm run photo-room:test
